tools.name: quote_fax
tools.description: Returns the price: $2.00 per fax by card for up to 100 pages (flat, no per-page charge); prepaid balance or MPP stablecoin: $0.02 per page. Also validates the number and PDF and returns a quote_id and payment link. Free; sends nothing. Call before send_fax.

tools.name: send_fax
tools.description: Returns the authorization instructions for sending a previously quoted fax. THIS ACTION COSTS MONEY AND CANNOT BE UNDONE: paying the returned link transmits a real document to a real fax machine. This tool itself does not charge you — it returns the price and a payment link, and the fax is only sent

tools.name: get_fax_status
tools.description: Current delivery state of a fax: awaiting_payment, paid, submitted, sending, delivered, or failed. Failed faxes include a reason you can act on.

tools.name: get_fax_receipt
tools.description: Verifiable delivery receipt for a completed fax. Available once the fax has reached a final state. Use this to prove the workflow finished.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "send_fax" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
